Podo Social API

Programmatic access for Agency Pro workspaces. Create a key in Dashboard → Social → API (shown once). Keys belong to one organisation and can be limited to a single client.

Base URL
https://social.podospheretechnologies.com/api/v1
Auth header
Authorization: Bearer ps_live_…
Plan
Agency Pro (`api` feature in plans)
Controls
Permissions · IP allowlist · daily request limit · call log

Auth

Send the Bearer token on every request. Revoked or missing keys return 401. Keys that fail the IP allowlist or lack a permission return 403. Daily limits reset at UTC midnight (429). `lastUsedAt` updates in the dashboard after each call.

Permissions

PermissionEndpoint
posts:writePOST /posts
analytics:readGET /analytics
leads:readGET /leads
whatsapp:sendPOST /whatsapp/send

Endpoints

POST/postsposts:write

Creates a draft, or schedules it when publishAt is set. Returns 201 with the created post group.

FieldTypeRequiredNotes
integrationIdstringyesChannel id from Dashboard → Channels
contentstringyes1–10,000 characters
publishAtISO date stringnoOmitted = draft
curl
curl -X POST https://social.podospheretechnologies.com/api/v1/posts \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ps_live_xxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"integrationId":"int_123","content":"Diwali sale is live","publishAt":"2026-11-20T13:30:00.000Z"}'
Node (fetch)
const res = await fetch("https://social.podospheretechnologies.com/api/v1/posts", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: "Bearer ps_live_xxx",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    integrationId: "int_123",
    content: "Diwali sale is live",
    publishAt: "2026-11-20T13:30:00.000Z",
  }),
});
const data = await res.json();
Python (requests)
import requests

r = requests.post(
    "https://social.podospheretechnologies.com/api/v1/posts",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer ps_live_xxx"},
    json={
        "integrationId": "int_123",
        "content": "Diwali sale is live",
        "publishAt": "2026-11-20T13:30:00.000Z",
    },
)
print(r.status_code, r.json())

Sample response shape matches the dashboard create-post payload (group + posts). Call staging once and paste the exact JSON here before launch if you need a frozen example.

GET/analyticsanalytics:read

Post counts for the last 30 days, scoped to the key’s organisation (and client, if limited).

GET/leadsleads:read

Leads list — same data as the Leads page, scoped to the key.

POST/whatsapp/sendwhatsapp:send

Sends a WhatsApp message. Body matches the dashboard send API (discriminated union on type).

FieldTypeRequiredNotes
type"text" | "template"yesMessage kind
tostringyesE.164 digits, e.g. 919876543210
textstringif textBody when type=text
templateNamestringif templateApproved template name
languagestringif templateTemplate language code
variablesstring[]noTemplate variables (default [])
curl (text)
curl -X POST https://social.podospheretechnologies.com/api/v1/whatsapp/send \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ps_live_xxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"type":"text","to":"919876543210","text":"Your order is confirmed"}'

Outgoing webhooks

Configure in Dashboard → Automation. Subscribe to publish and related events, inspect the payload, and use the in-app test button. Public short links live at /l/[code]; bio pages at /b/[slug].

Automation features →

Errors & limits

CodeMeaning
401Missing API key / key invalid or revoked
403Key lacks the permission, or IP not in allowlist
429Daily API limit reached (resets at UTC midnight)
4xxValidation error (zod); message names the field
